Self-contained notes for the course. Each note has the theory with every derivation, the assumptions of the method
with how to check them and what to do when they fail, and code that reproduces every plot and number.
The interactive figures are the same ones used in the [slides](../slides/index.html).

## Machine learning

| # | Note | Contents |
|---|---|---|
| 00 | [Supervised learning, splits and CV](machine_learning/00_supervised_learning.qmd) | problem setup, notation, empirical risk, bias–variance, train/val/test, k-fold CV, leakage |
| 01 | [Linear regression](machine_learning/01_linear_regression.qmd) | MSE loss, gradient, gradient descent, learning rate, normal equation, convexity, MLE, metrics |
| 02 | [Logistic regression](machine_learning/02_logistic_regression.qmd) | sigmoid, log-odds, cross-entropy = MLE, gradient, convexity, separability, classification metrics, calibration |
| 02b | [Generalised linear models](machine_learning/02b_generalized_linear_models.qmd) | distribution + linear score + link, one gradient and one convexity proof for all GLMs, Poisson regression |
| 03 | [Regularisation, inputs, assumptions](machine_learning/03_regularization_inputs_assumptions.qmd) | Ridge, Lasso, Elastic Net, MAP view; scaling, encoding, collinearity; model assumptions |
| 04 | [Softmax regression](machine_learning/04_softmax_regression.qmd) | softmax, categorical cross-entropy, gradient, convexity, multiclass metrics |
| 05 | [Support vector classifier](machine_learning/05_support_vector_classifier.qmd) | margin, the dual, soft margin, kernel trick, hinge loss, sub-gradient descent |
| 06 | [Decision trees and CART](machine_learning/06_decision_trees_cart.qmd) | impurity, split search, CART from scratch, regression trees, pruning |
| 07 | [Bagging, random forests, boosting](machine_learning/07_bagging_random_forest_boosting.qmd) | variance of an average, bootstrap and OOB, random forests, AdaBoost, gradient boosting |

## Neural networks

| # | Note | Contents |
|---|---|---|
| 00 | [Neural networks and the MLP](neural_networks/00_neural_networks_mlp.qmd) | neuron = logistic regression, XOR, forward pass, activations, losses as MLE, universal approximation |
| 01 | [Backpropagation](neural_networks/01_backpropagation.qmd) | chain rule on graphs, backprop derivation, gradient checking, initialisation, vanishing gradients |
| 02 | [Training: optimisation and regularisation](neural_networks/02_training_optimization_regularization.qmd) | SGD, momentum, Adam, schedules, learning curves, weight decay, dropout, normalisation |
| 03 | [CNNs, transfer and multi-task learning](neural_networks/03_cnn_transfer_multitask.qmd) | convolution, equivariance, pooling, receptive field, ResNet, transfer and multi-task learning |
| 04 | [Embeddings, RNNs and LSTMs](neural_networks/04_rnn_lstm.qmd) | embeddings, RNN, BPTT, vanishing gradients, LSTM and GRU |
| 05 | [Attention and transformers](neural_networks/05_attention_transformers.qmd) | BPE, attention, √d scaling, causal mask, multi-head, a tiny GPT, decoding |
| 06 | [Embeddings, retrieval and RAG](neural_networks/06_embeddings_rag.qmd) | similarity, TF-IDF, LSA, neural embeddings, nearest-neighbour search, retrieval metrics, RAG |

The hands-on labs are the notebooks in
[`notebooks/`](https://github.com/imagra93/ML-course-labs/tree/main/notebooks), each with an *Open in Colab* button.
